verdict.rationale: 1Password documents official SDKs in Go, JavaScript, and Python for building programmatic integrations, covering both loading secrets and managing items. An official GitHub repository for the JS SDK corroborates that the SDKs exist. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage depth (e.g., community reports or runtime probe of SDK functionality).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.
Automate item management: Programmatically manage items in your 1Password account.
Load secrets into your code with secret references or read environment variables from 1Password Environments.
Build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password.
